title: The Protocol of the Green Zone
author: Cyrus Dunmore
blurb: Marguerite Kavanagh, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
